# P35.52 — Tile retention and verifier (`sig.map-tiles/2`, ADR-156)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/330_P35.52__tile-retention-and-verifier.md`
(manifest row **330**, Round 11 / P35). Invoked `live_verification=false` —
exporter/renderer/manifest/verifier code, an ADR, CI wiring, fixtures and
tests only. **This row performs no hosted mutation, no live legs and no
publication:** the new archives take effect at the next republish under
its own row's authority; nothing public changes at merge.
Owned findings: **F-104** (the map rendered a few dozen points on a blank
canvas and never drew the bins) and **F-414** (its measured root cause —
tippecanoe default dropping kept ≈ 0.03 % of sites at z3, 5.7 % at z10,
25.6 % at z12); the tile half closes here, the island's rendering half is
MAP-03's recorded seam. Served: **SIG-GEO-012** (per-compartment overlay
tiles), **SIG-GEO-010** (tier/precision discipline — tier-2 polygon,
tier-3 never), **SIG-GEO-013** (attribution in every archive's metadata),
the **SIG-UI-016–020** region the findings cite (supply side), and
**SIG-FIND-005** (the nightly verifier runs over dep P35.51's real-sized
fixture). Cited: **ADR-118** (per-compartment separation — extended, its
§Decision 2 superseded by the basemap half), **ADR-106 §4** (licence-mixed
derived products stay restricted — why cells are summed in the browser,
never shipped), **K1 NEW-1**, **C4 DR-C4-13 / G3** (the verifier's §9.2.7
promotion role is G3's; this row builds the tool it calls). Writes
**ADR-156** (reserved number; agent-drafted and labelled). **Base:**
`r11/P35.51-page-budgets-lhci-fixture` (PR #349, head `f880c54`, 5/5
green at dispatch). **Gate:** none.

## The problem

The shipped tile path silently lied by omission. tippecanoe ran with its
default density dropping, so almost every published located record never
reached the public map; the pure-Python fallback coalesced distinct
entities sharing a grid cell (`_DEDUP_CELL`); and the density bins the
page promised were never drawn because no aggregate layer existed. A
cross-compartment count file could not fix that honestly — it would be a
licence-mixed derived database (ADR-106 §4). The fix is one contract:
retain every permitted feature in its zoom band, aggregate per
compartment, and verify the shipped bytes.

## What landed

- **`sig.map-tiles/2` archives** — one PMTiles per licence compartment,
  content-hash named `<compartment>-sites.<sha8>.pmtiles`, carrying two
  layers: `cells` (H3 count cells at z0–9; res 3/4/5/6 over the
  z0–4/5–6/7–8/9 bands) and `sites` (tier 0 from z10, tier 1 from z11,
  tier 2 from z12 as its res-8 H3 polygon ≈ the declared ~1 km bin,
  tier 3 never). Every feature gets a `tippecanoe` `{layer, minzoom,
  maxzoom}` member; tippecanoe runs with `-r1` and the argv guard refuses
  `--drop-*`/`--coalesce*`/`--cluster-distance`/`--maximum-tile-bytes`/
  `--base-zoom`; a stored tile over 500 KiB fails the build loudly (warn
  at 200 KiB). The pure-Python renderer honours the same ranges, encodes
  MVT polygons, and dedupes only byte-identical features.
- **`web/tiles/index.json`** (`sig.map-tiles-index/1` inside the
  `sig.map-tiles/2` contract) — per archive: compartment, hashed path,
  sha256, licence, attribution, bounds, min/max zoom, counts, renderer +
  renderer_version, contract, and the source GeoJSON it verifies against.
  Archives and the index register in the export manifests; missing
  manifests stay fail-closed; an honestly empty index is legal. nginx
  serves hashed archives `immutable` (D12 fixed); index + legacy names
  revalidate.
- **`sig-exports tiles verify --in <dir>`** — writes
  `reports/tiles_verify.json`; five in-tool checks per archive:
  count conservation (Σ`n` over distinct cells at z0–9, `rk` sets per
  tier band at z10–14, no sites below z10 / no cells above z9), renderer
  parity vs a fresh pure-Python replay (honestly `vacuous` only when the
  shipped archive was itself pure-Python), precision/tier/property
  vocabulary (tier-1 coordinate fidelity vs source; foreign keys fail;
  tier-3 absent), size, and metadata equality across archive ↔ index ↔
  manifest; the sixth check — CI wiring — lives in the workflows.
- **CI + fixtures** — `build_tippecanoe.sh` compiles the pinned
  tippecanoe 2.79.0 from the `ops/Dockerfile` ARGs (tarball sha256
  checked), cached by pin; the web job runs `tile_verify_leg.sh
  fixture|verify` over a deterministic 50k synthetic fixture (clustered
  cities, co-located, byte-identical twins, three compartments, all
  tiers); nightly runs `national|verify` over the real-sized corpus with
  the report-gate wiring the other legs use. `make check-tile-verify`
  mirrors the leg for the `ci-local` parity gate.
- **Web** — `NATIONAL_ZOOM_MAX = 9`; one PMTiles source per compartment
  plus an in-memory summed-count layer the island computes from the
  active sources' `cells` features (licence separation preserved — the
  sum exists only in the browser); `sites` circle + tier-2 fill layers;
  per-source attribution; hashed paths resolve through `index.json`; the
  no-JS table and fixture-mode inline points stand.
- **ADR-156** — records the contract: two layers, retention, dual-renderer
  parity, the manifest fields, and the self-hosted-OSM-basemap direction
  ADR-170 frames (reverses Round-9 Q8 at the operator's U-003.1 request;
  supersedes ADR-118 §Decision 2; consumes ADR-155). Appendix F row added
  through spec_src; trigger register row under BL-077.

## Verification

- `make check`: lint, format, mypy (385 files), pytest, `verify-gen`
  byte-identical — green; Docker was present so `tests/db` + `tests/e2e`
  really ran (not skipped). Two residuals are environmental, not this
  diff, and are recorded in the run ledger: the GCP project-id leak check
  fails closed because `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` is unset locally (armed by
  `vars.SIG_GCP_PROJECT` in CI), and the two P34.18 handle scans see a
  gitignored local handle list — all hits sit in unmodified append-only
  build memory (in CI the absent list skips them).
- `npm --prefix web run check`: typecheck 0 errors, 536 unit tests, build,
  licence gate, 501 e2e — green.
- `make check-tile-verify` locally: pinned tippecanoe built + cache-hit,
  the 50k fixture rendered **by tippecanoe**, verifier `pass` over 3
  archives with parity `vacuous: false` and zero diffs.
- `make docs-check`: all detectors green; the regenerated current-state
  projection verifies 1094/1094 input digests.
